title: add T&C's to registration
body:
we need a checkbox that confirms the user has read the t&c's upon registration - here is the text: https://github.com/dotmesh-io/legal/blob/master/termsfeed-terms-conditions-text-english.txt

we can host this on the marketing site and link to it from the registration
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: In the tickbox text, we should have a nod to GDPR as well: see https://github.com/dotmesh-io/legal/issues/1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: If you head over to [the registration form](https://saas.dotmesh.io/ui/register) there is now a place to put the message and a link to somewhere - can someone put what those two things should be on this issue and I can add/close - thanks!

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: [this issue](https://github.com/dotmesh-io/non-coding-tasks/issues/11) is for writing the T&C's - given that text I can make the page with @petercolesdc

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
